notes:
— Summary: Large North American financial services platform evaluating Redwood for real-time fraud/risk scoring and high-volume reranking. Ultimately chose to self-host (vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM) citing cost and strict control requirements.

— Key selling points they liked: predictable latency, model pinning, rollout control, Redwood Console traces.

— Why they left: brief bullets, taken from multiple calls and emails:
  * "We need full stack control — vendor blackbox is a regulatory no-go" (security lead).
  * Cost math: infra team estimates 40–60% lower inference unit cost once amortized over steady-state throughput (they ran a three-week perf run).
  * Budget freeze Q1 delayed any procurement; when budget opened infra had already delivered a minimum viable infra.
  * No internal champion in product org after reorg — infra + platform team opted to standardize on internal toolkit.

— Security notes / concerns captured during review:
  * Requested long-term retention controls and regional residency for transaction logs — must be on-customer-network (can't be multi-tenant hosted).
  * Required HSM/KMS integration and quarterly audit reporting.
  * Legal asked for indemnity language around model outputs (they didn't accept Redwood standard terms without legal escalation).

— PoC specifics: proposed 6x A100 reserved + autoscale for burst, custom KV-cache config to meet <50ms tail for short chat queries, batching for embeddings. They rejected cost delta.

— Competitive/tech notes: they've chosen vLLM for inference orchestration, TGI for adapter compatibility and community models, and TensorRT-LLM for production kernels on their DGX cluster. Mentioned using Triton to expose endpoints behind internal API gateway.

— Stalled/closed reason (short): self-hosted for control/cost + procurement freeze + no internal champion.

— Next steps recommended to AE/RevOps:
  * Do a formal closed-lost post-mortem with SE + security to capture exact delta in cost/perf (ask infra for perf run artifacts).
  * Create a one-pager comparing Redwood hosted/dedicated TCO vs vLLM + TensorRT with realistic assumptions (GPU amortization, ops headcount).
  * Re-open in 3–6 months to check on ops overhead and whether they hit quality/regression issues.

— Quotes/snippets:
  * "We can't hand over transaction logs to a multi-tenant vendor." — Head of Infra
  * "Once our SREs tune TensorRT we see the unit economics line up." — Platform eng lead

— Internal flags: mark as closed-lost reason: self-host. Add to competitor intelligence: vLLM/TGI/TensorRT.
